threads.body: The Cohere schema is less constrained than the equivalent structured-output schemas: the OpenAI, Mistral, and LiteLLM scenarios all set `additionalProperties` to false. Since these scenarios are intended to make the same exchange, include the same constraint here so any schema-related telemetry remains comparable.

+"""Conformance scenario: a Cohere chat with a JSON schema answer.
+
+Asking for a schema is what ``gen_ai.output.type`` describes, so the request
+names one rather than only asking for "some JSON". Cohere carries the schema
+inside a ``json_object`` response format rather than a type of its own.

+
